newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 314 OF DECEMBER 4, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 314 OF DECEMBER 4, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

Corrigendum to Council Directive 96/29/Euratom of 13 May 1996 laying down basic safety standards for the protection of the health of workers and the general public against the dangers arising from ionizing radiation (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 159 of 29 June 1996)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2319/96 of 3 December 1996 concerning applications for import licences for quality wheat qualifying for the conditions referred to in Council Regulation (EC) No 774/94
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2318/96 of 3 December 1996 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2317/96 of 3 December 1996 amending the import duties in the cereals sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2316/96 of 3 December 1996 altering the export refunds on cereals and on wheat or rye flour, groats and meal

COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 2315/96 of 25 November 1996 establishing, pursuant to Article 1 (7) of Regulation (EEC) 3030/93, the list of textiles and clothing products to be integrated into GATT 1994 on 1 January 1998 and amending Annex X to Regulation (EEC) No 3030/93 and Annex II to Regulation (EC) No 3285/94 END OF DOCUMENT.
